warps.text: Attempt to Counteract one additional eligible effect affecting the same target

system.description:
FOLKWARDEN HEALING SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 creature

You break a knotted thread, scatter prepared herbs, extinguish a marked candle or perform another traditional act symbolising the severing of harmful influence.
Select one effect currently affecting the target possessing one of the following characteristics:
Curse;
Charm or Compulsion;
possession; magical Fear; or
another Mental or Soul effect that directly controls, coerces or unnaturally alters the target's behaviour.
Attempt to Counteract the selected effect.
Critical The effect ends, and the target gains a +2-status bonus to saving throws against that same source for 1 hour.
Success The effect ends.
Failure The effect remains.
Fumble The effect remains, and you cannot attempt to Break the Evil Eye against that particular effect again until your next daily preparation.
The spell cannot remove ordinary emotions, voluntarily accepted magical effects or mundane coercion.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the range to 30 feet.
+4 PP: Attempt to Counteract one additional eligible effect affecting the same target.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
